testcase.name: a track's line-width is a linear zoom interpolation from its stops
the stops are 25 percent at zoom 12, 42 at 14, 67 at 16 and the full width at 18
each casing keeps today's 1,5 ratio to its line at every zoom
the offline outline stays a constant 1,5 dp while the tracks thin out
below zoom 12 and above zoom 18 the width holds, and between the stops it is linear
each track line is 1,5 2,52 4,02 and 6 dp at zoom 12 14 16 and 18, and each casing 2,25 3,78 6,03 and 9 dp
